caption: The drawing consists of a collection of interconnected metallic objects rendered in shades of grey, with some sections highlighted in white and subtle blue-gray. At the top, there is a large, circular disk featuring a symmetrical floral or starburst pattern etched into its surface, bordered by a ring of repeating triangular designs. This circular disk overlaps with a smaller, solid dark disk. Both disks are attached to an elongated, curved metallic rod, which forms a loop at its top end and serves as a structural support for the other elements. Below the disks are two articulated, ornately decorated mechanical arms, each accented with swirling designs, segmented joints, and rounded bolts. The left arm curves outward and downward, tapering into a rounded end with a small protrusion, while the right arm follows a straighter path. A small, diamond-shaped flat piece jutting from the left arm, and a striped black-and-white element, resembling a spring or flexible connector, extends between the arms. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background with the name "HARRY MAUN WADDELL" written in small letters in the lower right quadrant.
title: Ring Bit
